stem.text: An object of mass $m$ travelling with speed $5u$ collides with, and sticks to, an object of mass $5m$ travelling in the same direction with speed $u$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a small circle labelled m with an arrow labelled 5u above it, and a larger circle labelled 5m with an arrow labelled u above it, both arrows pointing right.

stem.text: What is the speed with which the two objects travel together in the original direction?
